verdict.rationale: incident.io ships built-in AI that does work for responders. Investigations is an agent that 'does the legwork a responder normally would': it gathers evidence and tests hypotheses within user-set bounds. The changelog says users 'can now update your status page using the agent', and the AI also drafts postmortems, updates, summaries and follow-ups, with Scribe transcribing calls. The external MCP server is not credited here. Missing for 10: first-party docs on the in-product agent's interface and the full range of tasks it accepts (only a single changelog line), and independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation.
